name: roomi-fields
description: Open-source plugins by roomi-fields for Claude Code: RTFM (retrieval layer), NotebookLM (citation-backed Q&A), osc-bridge (MIDI & OSC bridge for synths/DAWs), electra-one (custom widgets & presets for the Electra One MIDI controller), and paper-trail (anti-hallucination academic research workflow).

plugins.name: rtfm
plugins.description: The open retrieval layer for AI agents. Indexes code, docs, legal, research, data with FTS5 + optional embeddings. Serves surgical context via MCP. Pure-Python plugin — no pip install required.

plugins.name: notebooklm
plugins.description: Automate Google NotebookLM at scale. Citation-backed Q&A, full Studio generation (audio, video, infographic, report, presentation, data table), multi-account rotation with auto-reauth, and batch_to_vault for offline RTFM-ingestable answer caching. Ships a bundled notebooklm skill that primes Claude with citation formats, the daily-quota-aware batch pattern, and transport selection.

plugins.name: notebooklm-skill
plugins.description: Skill-only companion to the notebooklm plugin: teaches Claude how to query Google NotebookLM well — citation formats, the daily-quota-aware batch-to-cache pattern, Studio generation, and transport selection. Requires the engine (install the notebooklm plugin, which already bundles this skill, or run the @roomi-fields/notebooklm-mcp server). Install this one only if you want the skill without the MCP server.

plugins.name: osc-bridge
plugins.description: Declarative OSC bridge for music hardware and software — 849 synthesizer drivers (MIDI/SysEx) plus DAW & live-coding targets (Ableton, Bitwig, Reaper, Sonic Pi, SuperCollider). A MIDI MCP and OSC MCP: discover the device catalogue, read a device's OSC surface, send OSC to synths and DAWs from Claude.

plugins.name: osc-bridge-skill
plugins.description: Skill-only companion to the osc-bridge plugin: teaches Claude to drive music gear well — finding the right driver among 849 synths, the OSC-to-CC/NRPN/SysEx mapping, the two-process architecture (MCP server plus the running bridge), per-DAW host setup (Ableton, Bitwig, Reaper) and live-coding targets, plus the failure modes that are silent by design. Requires the osc-bridge engine and a clone of its device catalogue.

plugins.name: electra-one
plugins.description: Develop Electra One MK2/Mini widgets and presets from Claude Code. Push to device over USB SysEx, capture Lua logs, search the indexed official documentation, validate preset JSON. Ships with an always-on skill that primes Claude with the verified Lua API and the device-side gotchas confirmed empirically (graphics.print signature, integer-coord requirement, 1-pot-per-custom-tile firmware limit, IIFE-free bundling, slotId 0-indexed, etc.).

plugins.name: paper-trail
plugins.description: Anti-hallucination plugin for academic research. Creates state-of-the-art reviews guaranteed without fabrication, audits existing SOTAs/articles (purge or warnings), with a strict validation engine (8-state FSM + 8-source PDF acquisition cascade (up to 11 with opt-in extended sources) + page-1 anti-homonymy validation + 19 registry invariants). Generic multi-domain workflow with Obsidian adapter by default. Optional extended acquisition sources are disabled by default (explicit opt-in only; see DISCLAIMER).
